opennyai_summary.final__facts:

After rejection of the first bail application of applicant, statement of victim girl has been recorded before the trial court.

The allegation that the applicant has committed rape upon the victim, is wholly false.
The victim has not sustained any injury.
Learned counsel has referred part cross-examination of victim /
PW-2 and submitted that no case for rape is made out and even if her version is believed it is a case of mere molestation.

Applicant is uncle of victim girl.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
5. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, age and statement of victim girl and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, no case for grant of bail is made out.

the instant second bail application filed on behalf of applicant Raju Agrahari is hereby rejected.
